title: Grouped Query Attention
hint: Like MHA but fewer KV heads. W_k/W_v project to num_kv_heads * d_k dims. Use repeat_interleave to expand KV heads to match Q heads.

description.text: Implement grouped query attention (GQA) as in LLaMA 2: use fewer KV heads than query heads and share K/V across groups of query heads to reduce memory and compute while preserving multi-head expressiveness.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
